objectives: Decode taught sn-words by mapping graphemes from left to right.
Blend the sn onset with the vowel and remaining sounds.
Distinguish sn from other taught blends without guessing.
Self-correct by checking every grapheme and rereading the word.
concepts: Decoding maps graphemes to sounds in order.
The sn onset contains s then n.
Every remaining grapheme must be decoded.
Rereading checks that no sound was omitted.

definitions.definition: A letter or group of letters representing a speech sound.
Use grapheme-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Notice and repair an error using sound and word evidence.

workedExamples.solution: Map s-n-a-p, blend the sounds, then say snap.
Keep s and n in order, then read the rest.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads snip as sip. What should happen?
workedExamples.solution: Return to n after s, map each grapheme, and reread snip.
